response.rationale: R1 integrates the COL7A1 compound heterozygous splice-site cause with the decisive mosaic-reversion evidence of 35.0% wild-type transcripts in the potentially revertant epidermis and the explicitly labeled revertant skin patch on the left forearm. R3 correctly identifies dystrophic epidermolysis bullosa from COL7A1, ulcer, and collagen/anchoring-fibril findings, but it omits the revertant mosaicism that makes the diagnosis composite and specific. C1 is only an append-only genetic completion of R3, repeating COL7A1 evidence without adding new raw support.

rejected.why: C1 is a redundant append-only completion of R3; its raw spans merely restate compound heterozygous COL7A1 findings and it adds no revertant mosaicism or independent diagnostic evidence.
